baroPresent.name: BaroPresent
baroPresent.desc: 1 if the BMP581 answered at init, else 0

imuPresent.name: ImuPresent
imuPresent.desc: 1 if the ICM-42688-P answered at init, else 0

gyroX.name: ImuGyroX
gyroX.desc: ICM-42688-P angular rate X (RAW, no bias estimator)

gyroY.name: ImuGyroY
gyroY.desc: ICM-42688-P angular rate Y (RAW, no bias estimator)

gyroZ.name: ImuGyroZ
gyroZ.desc: ICM-42688-P angular rate Z (RAW, no bias estimator)

coreExecUs.name: Core{i}ExecTime
coreExecUs.desc: CPU0 busy time in the last 100 ms window

coreLoadPmil.name: Core{i}Load
coreLoadPmil.desc: CPU0 busy fraction of the window

coreAlive.name: Core{i}Alive
coreAlive.desc: CPU0 liveness counter, frozen if the core hung

ethBytesPerSec.name: EthBytesPerSec
ethBytesPerSec.desc: Ethernet throughput, transmit and receive summed

ethUtilPmil.name: EthUtilisation
ethUtilPmil.desc: link utilisation against the negotiated line rate

magPresent.name: MagPresent
magPresent.desc: 1 if the MMC5983MA answered at init, else 0

magFieldG.name: MagFieldMagnitude
magFieldG.desc: total field |B| - independent of orientation, ~0.48 G in Munich

magHeadingDeg.name: MagHeading
magHeadingDeg.desc: heading from X/Y - LEVEL ONLY, uncalibrated, no declination

gnssrxBytes.name: GnssRxBytes
gnssrxBytes.desc: NEO-M9N bytes received on ASCLIN4 since boot - the primary link-health signal

gnsssentences.name: GnssSentences
gnsssentences.desc: complete NMEA sentences assembled - ~6/s at the 1 Hz default nav rate

gnsserrors.name: GnssErrors
gnsserrors.desc: ASCLIN framing errors + RX FIFO overflows - must stay 0 on a healthy link

gnssfixType.name: GnssFixType
gnssfixType.desc: fix quality - PHASE B, currently always 0 (no NMEA parser yet)

gnssnumSats.name: GnssNumSats
gnssnumSats.desc: satellites used in the solution - PHASE B, currently always 0

gnssPresent.name: GnssPresent
gnssPresent.desc: 1 if the NEO-M9N is answering (link alive), else 0

gnssfixOk.name: GnssFixOk
gnssfixOk.desc: 1 = the receiver says the solution is valid (gnssFixOK set, invalidLlh clear). Necessary but NOT sufficient - use GnssNavOk

gnsssec.name: GnssSecond
gnsssec.desc: UTC second, 0..60 (60 during a leap second)

gnsslatDeg.name: GnssLatitude
gnsslatDeg.desc: latitude from UBX-NAV-PVT, WGS84. Stored as float32 so ~0.4 m of the receiver's 1.1 cm resolution is lost - well below its ~1.5 m accuracy

gnssaltM.name: GnssAltitude
gnssaltM.desc: height above mean sea level (NAV-PVT hMSL)

gnssheadingDeg.name: GnssHeading
gnssheadingDeg.desc: 2-D heading of motion (NAV-PVT headMot); meaningless when stationary

gnsshAccM.name: GnssHAccuracy
gnsshAccM.desc: horizontal accuracy estimate (NAV-PVT hAcc) - the number that says whether the fix is trustworthy

gnsstimeOk.name: GnssTimeOk
gnsstimeOk.desc: 1 = UTC date and time are fully resolved. When 0 the date/time fields read 0 - the receiver's own free-running clock is NOT published, it looks like real data

gnssnavOk.name: GnssNavOk
gnssnavOk.desc: THE flag to gate sensor fusion on: fix valid AND 3D AND horizontal accuracy within 10 m. Independent of GnssTimeOk

gnssvAccM.name: GnssVAccuracy
gnssvAccM.desc: vertical accuracy estimate (NAV-PVT vAcc). Typically 1.5-2x worse than horizontal - all satellites are above the receiver, so the geometry for the vertical component is poor

fusionInnov.name: FusionInnovation
fusionInnov.desc: barometer innovation: measured altitude minus the filter's prediction. Zero-mean noise means the filter is consistent; a constant offset means the model is missing a term (in stage 3 that offset IS the un-modelled accelerometer bias)

fusionP00.name: FusionVarAltitude
fusionP00.desc: filter variance of a_d [m^2]. Grows on every predict, shrinks on every barometer correction; it should settle rather than run away

fusionRejects.name: FusionBaroRejects
fusionRejects.desc: barometer samples rejected by the 5-sigma outlier gate. A rising count is a sensor fault, not a tuning knob

fusionElapsed.name: FusionDt
fusionElapsed.desc: measured interval between IMU task runs, the dt the filter integrates with. Nominal 0.020 s; measured rather than assumed so scheduler jitter cannot bias the integral

a_D.name: FusionAccelDown
a_D.desc: acceleration along NED down with gravity removed, the filter's input. Zero at rest and level; NEGATIVE while accelerating upward. LEVEL-SCAFFOLD ONLY until an attitude estimate exists

a_d.name: FusionAltitudeDown
a_d.desc: estimated position along NED down, relative to the first valid barometer sample. POSITIVE IS DOWN, so climbing makes this go negative

a_v_d.name: FusionVelocityDown
a_v_d.desc: estimated velocity along NED down. POSITIVE IS DOWN: sinking is positive, climbing negative

fusionResets.name: FusionResets
fusionResets.desc: filter re-acquisitions: the barometer was rejected for 0.5 s straight, so the state was reloaded from it. Non-zero means the filter diverged and recovered -- investigate what threw it off

tempDeltaMax.name: CAL_tempDeltaMax
tempDeltaMax.desc: max plausible delta DTS vs DTSC

command.name: NVM_command
command.desc: NVM command: 0x45564153 SAVE, 0x544C4644 load defaults; firmware clears to 0

userValue.name: NVM_userValue
userValue.desc: persistent user scratch word (survives reset after SAVE)

seaLevelPa.name: NVM_seaLevelPa
seaLevelPa.desc: sea-level reference pressure for BaroAltitude - set to local QNH

magOffX.name: NvmMagOffX
magOffX.desc: hard-iron offset X, sensor frame; subtract before use

magScaleX.name: NvmMagScaleX
magScaleX.desc: soft-iron scale X; 1.0 is no correction

magDeclDeg.name: NvmMagDeclination
magDeclDeg.desc: magnetic declination, east positive; +3.9 in Munich. Turns magnetic north into true north

mode._why: read-only, published by firmware from gpio_cfg.h; writes are rejected

duty.name: GPIO_P00_{i2}_duty
duty.desc: P00.{i} PWM duty cycle (effective only if pin is PWM in gpio_cfg.h)

DIAG_UART_DISCONNECTED.name: Diag_UartDisconnected
DIAG_UART_DISCONNECTED.desc: no UART heartbeat from PC GUI for > 2 s

DIAG_NVM_FAULT.name: Diag_NvmFault
DIAG_NVM_FAULT.desc: NVM corrupt at boot or last save failed

DIAG_I2C_SCL_STUCK.name: Diag_I2cSclStuck
DIAG_I2C_SCL_STUCK.desc: I2C0 SCL held low: short to GND or a slave stretching the clock

DIAG_I2C_SDA_STUCK.name: Diag_I2cSdaStuck
DIAG_I2C_SDA_STUCK.desc: I2C0 SDA held low: short to GND or a slave jammed mid-byte

DIAG_BARO_NO_RESPONSE.name: Diag_BaroNoResponse
DIAG_BARO_NO_RESPONSE.desc: BMP581 never answered since boot: wiring, address or dead part

DIAG_BARO_TIMEOUT.name: Diag_BaroTimeout
DIAG_BARO_TIMEOUT.desc: BMP581 answered before and is now silent for > 1 s

DIAG_BARO_STUCK_DATA.name: Diag_BaroStuckData
DIAG_BARO_STUCK_DATA.desc: BMP581 bus healthy but the value stopped changing for > 5 s

DIAG_IMU_NO_RESPONSE.name: Diag_ImuNoResponse
DIAG_IMU_NO_RESPONSE.desc: ICM-42688-P never answered since boot: level shifters, CS, SPI mode or MRST pad

DIAG_IMU_TIMEOUT.name: Diag_ImuTimeout
DIAG_IMU_TIMEOUT.desc: ICM-42688-P answered before and is now silent for > 1 s

DIAG_IMU_STUCK_DATA.name: Diag_ImuStuckData
DIAG_IMU_STUCK_DATA.desc: ICM-42688-P bus healthy but the sample block stopped changing for > 5 s

DIAG_IMU_IMPLAUSIBLE.name: Diag_ImuImplausible
DIAG_IMU_IMPLAUSIBLE.desc: ICM-42688-P |a| outside 0.05..17 g or temperature outside -40..85 degC

DIAG_MAG_NO_RESPONSE.name: Diag_MagNoResponse
DIAG_MAG_NO_RESPONSE.desc: MMC5983MA never answered since boot: wiring, or CS not tied to +3V3

DIAG_MAG_TIMEOUT.name: Diag_MagTimeout
DIAG_MAG_TIMEOUT.desc: MMC5983MA answered before and is now silent for > 1 s

DIAG_MAG_STUCK_DATA.name: Diag_MagStuckData
DIAG_MAG_STUCK_DATA.desc: MMC5983MA bus healthy but the field stopped changing for > 5 s

DIAG_MAG_IMPLAUSIBLE.name: Diag_MagImplausible
DIAG_MAG_IMPLAUSIBLE.desc: MMC5983MA |B| outside 0.15..2.0 G - wrong scaling or axis assembly

DIAG_GNSS_NO_RESPONSE.name: Diag_GnssNoResponse
DIAG_GNSS_NO_RESPONSE.desc: NEO-M9N never sent a byte since boot: wiring, baud rate, or module unpowered

DIAG_GNSS_TIMEOUT.name: Diag_GnssTimeout
DIAG_GNSS_TIMEOUT.desc: NEO-M9N was streaming and has now been silent for > 2 s

DIAG_GNSS_STUCK_DATA.name: Diag_GnssStuckData
DIAG_GNSS_STUCK_DATA.desc: GnssRxBytes stopped advancing - for a stream device this is the same fault as Timeout

DIAG_GNSS_IMPLAUSIBLE.name: Diag_GnssImplausible
DIAG_GNSS_IMPLAUSIBLE.desc: NEO-M9N data quality fault - NOT YET WIRED, the plausible input is hardcoded TRUE

DIAG_CAL_INVALID.name: Diag_CalInvalid
DIAG_CAL_INVALID.desc: calibration block magic broken, defaults reloaded

tickMs.name: NavTickMs
tickMs.desc: uptime when the navigation block was last written

rollDeg.name: AttRoll
rollDeg.desc: roll angle, positive right side down

pitchDeg.name: AttPitch
pitchDeg.desc: pitch angle, positive nose up; clamped at +/-90

yawDeg.name: AttYaw
yawDeg.desc: heading, true north when the NVM declination is set

gyroBias.name: AttGyroBias{i}
gyroBias.desc: estimated gyro bias on axis {i}; boot calibration plus tracked drift

accNed.name: AttAccNed{i}
accNed.desc: acceleration along NED axis {i} with gravity removed

accMagG.name: AttAccMagnitude
accMagG.desc: |a|, the orientation-independent health check; 1.0 at rest

magFieldG.name: AttMagFieldCorrected
magFieldG.desc: |B| after hard-iron correction; must not change as the board rotates

accTrusted.name: AttAccTrusted
accTrusted.desc: 1 while |a| is close enough to 1 g for gravity to dominate

magTrusted.name: AttMagTrusted
magTrusted.desc: 1 while |B| is plausible and is correcting yaw

posD.name: NavPosDown
posD.desc: position along NED down, relative to the origin; POSITIVE IS DOWN

velD.name: NavVelDown
velD.desc: velocity along NED down; positive is descending

accBiasD.name: NavAccBiasDown
accBiasD.desc: estimated accelerometer bias on the down axis; ~0.01..0.02 on this board

baroBias.name: NavBaroBias
baroBias.desc: barometer offset against GNSS altitude - the weather drift, not the sensor

innovD.name: NavInnovDown
innovD.desc: barometer innovation: what the baro said minus what the filter expected

varD.name: NavVarDown
varD.desc: variance of PosDown; sqrt of this is the altitude uncertainty

posN.name: NavPosNorth
posN.desc: metres north of the tangent-plane origin (first usable GNSS fix)

posE.name: NavPosEast
posE.desc: metres east of the tangent-plane origin

accBiasN.name: NavAccBiasNorth
accBiasN.desc: estimated accelerometer bias north; mostly absorbs attitude error

varN.name: NavVarNorth
varN.desc: variance of PosNorth; grows without bound until a GNSS fix arrives

originAltM.name: NavOriginAlt
originAltM.desc: GNSS altitude at the origin fix, above mean sea level

baroRejects.name: NavBaroRejects
baroRejects.desc: barometer samples rejected by the outlier gate; a rising count is a sensor fault, not a tuning knob

baroResets.name: NavBaroResets
baroResets.desc: vertical re-acquisitions after a run of rejections; non-zero means the filter diverged and recovered

gnssRejects.name: NavGnssRejects
gnssRejects.desc: GNSS fixes rejected by the outlier gate

gnssUpdates.name: NavGnssUpdates
gnssUpdates.desc: GNSS fixes actually fused; increments once per new iTOW, i.e. 1 Hz with a fix

verticalOk.name: NavVerticalOk
verticalOk.desc: 1 once the barometer has anchored the vertical channel

horizontalOk.name: NavHorizontalOk
horizontalOk.desc: 1 once GNSS has anchored the horizontal channels

originSet.name: NavOriginSet
originSet.desc: 1 once a usable fix defined the tangent-plane origin

covResets.name: NavCovResets
covResets.desc: numerical health-check trips. MUST stay 0 - any other value is a bug, not a tuning problem

gnssITow.name: NavGnssITow
gnssITow.desc: GPS time of week of the last fix actually fused; frozen with gnssUpdates stalled means iTOW is not being decoded

gnssDupes.name: NavGnssDupes
gnssDupes.desc: polls that carried an already-fused fix; small but non-zero is healthy, exactly zero or near the poll rate is a fault

ahrsBiasDegraded.name: AttBiasDegraded
ahrsBiasDegraded.desc: 1 = the boot gyro-bias calibration hit its 10 s deadline instead of completing a still window, i.e. the board was moving at power-on. The estimate still runs, it is just less good

phi_ist.name: CtrlPhiIst{i}
phi_ist.desc: FLIGHT CONTROL FEEDBACK: attitude for att_ctrl_step, element {i} of [roll, pitch, yaw]. RADIANS, not degrees - this is the controller's own unit

om_ist.name: CtrlOmIst{i}
om_ist.desc: FLIGHT CONTROL FEEDBACK: body rate for rate_ctrl_step, element {i} of [p, q, r]. RAD/S

p_ned_ist.name: CtrlPNedIst{i}
p_ned_ist.desc: FLIGHT CONTROL FEEDBACK: position for pos_ctrl_step, element {i} of [north, east, down]

v_b_ist.name: CtrlVBIst{i}
v_b_ist.desc: FLIGHT CONTROL FEEDBACK: velocity for pos_ctrl_step, element {i} of [u, v, w]. BODY frame, rotated out of NED by the current attitude - feeding it NED velocity would make the damping term wrong by the heading angle

navDropped.name: NavDropped
navDropped.desc: measurements refused at the filter input as NaN, infinite or absurd. MUST be 0 with healthy sensors - a rising count IS a failing sensor. Exists because a bad sample cannot be caught later: the outlier gate cannot see a NaN (every comparison against NaN is false, so it is not an outlier) and the covariance check does not fire either, because P stays finite while the state goes NaN

twoKpAcc.name: FusKpAccel
twoKpAcc.desc: TUNING - attitude: how hard the accelerometer pulls the gyro integral back toward gravity. Higher = tracks gravity faster but inherits vibration; lower = smoother but gyro drift shows. Fixes ROLL and PITCH only

twoKpMag.name: FusKpMag
twoKpMag.desc: TUNING - attitude: same, for the magnetometer, which fixes YAW only. Deliberately half the accelerometer gain: indoors the magnetic field is the less trustworthy of the two

twoKi.name: FusKiGyroBias
twoKi.desc: TUNING - attitude: integral gain that tracks slow gyro-bias drift. Small, because the boot calibration already removed the bulk of it

sigmaAccD.name: FusSigmaAccDown
sigmaAccD.desc: TUNING - vertical: how much the filter distrusts the accelerometer when predicting altitude. THE knob to raise once motors are running, because vibration is not in the 0.3 measured on a desk

sigmaBaro.name: FusSigmaBaro
sigmaBaro.desc: TUNING - vertical: barometer noise. MEASURED (0.0197 m); R is this value SQUARED. Changing the BMP581 IIR setting invalidates it - re-measure, do not guess

sigmaBaroRw.name: FusSigmaBaroDrift
sigmaBaroRw.desc: TUNING - vertical: how fast the barometer's zero wanders with weather. Measured 0.19 m/min on a still desk. This is the WEATHER, not the sensor

tauBaroBias.name: FusTauBaroDrift
tauBaroBias.desc: TUNING - vertical: time constant over which that barometer drift reverts toward zero. Without mean reversion the altitude variance grows without bound, because a barometer alone can only ever observe (altitude + drift), never either one

sigmaAccH.name: FusSigmaAccHoriz
sigmaAccH.desc: TUNING - horizontal: accelerometer distrust for north/east. Larger than the vertical one because horizontal acceleration is contaminated by ATTITUDE error - one degree of tilt error tips 0.17 m/s^2 of gravity into the horizontal plane

sigmaGnssVel.name: FusSigmaGnssVel
sigmaGnssVel.desc: TUNING - horizontal: GNSS velocity noise. Currently pessimistic at 0.3 against a receiver good to about 0.05 - this is Doppler-derived and is the best measurement available for a position loop

gnssPosRScale.name: FusGnssPosRScale
gnssPosRScale.desc: TUNING - horizontal: multiplies the GNSS position R. 1.0 trusts hAcc as a single independent fix, which is WRONG at 10 Hz because consecutive solutions share most of their information. Set to 8.0 after the outdoor run showed varN claiming 0.3 m against a real 2.59 m

gateSigmaSq.name: FusGateSigmaSq
gateSigmaSq.desc: TUNING - outlier gate, in sigma SQUARED (25 = 5 sigma). Rejects a measurement this far from what the filter expected

gateMinM.name: FusGateMinMetres
gateMinM.desc: TUNING - absolute floor on the barometer gate. Without it the gate converges to +/-0.1 m and starts rejecting real motion: a 30 cm hand lift already reached 62 percent of it. The gate is for CORRUPT readings, not for manoeuvres
